capabilities: track active vault and markdown file in ActivityWatch
send watcher data to the local ActivityWatch server
show per-file time in ActivityWatch timeline and evaluation view
extras: README notes the plugin was not yet approved for Obsidian's community plugin list at time of writing; multi-device data sharing is left to ActivityWatch itself.
problem: Obsidian does not report per-file usage time to external time trackers, so time spent in vaults is invisible to ActivityWatch.

relations.evidence: ActivityWatch is an open source time tracker capable of keeping track how much time is spent using which program.

summary: Integrates with ActivityWatch, sending vault and file names to it so it can track time spent on notes.
